canonicalResolution.rationale: ArcLight's 2025 ESG report explicitly writes the identity as Digital Generation (d/b/a Takanock) and defines Takanock as the short form. The SEC Form D and company materials identify the legal issuer and operating platform as Takanock, LLC. This is the existing production and evaluated-seed company, not a second portfolio company.
canonicalResolution.platformBoundary: Takanock, LLC is the manager-level digital-power platform. Project Baccara and other site or project entities are subsidiaries or assets beneath it and are not separate PortCos.

currentOwners.stake: Part of a collective majority interest; individual percentage not publicly disclosed
currentOwners.vehicle: Jointly managed ArcLight / DigitalBridge investment vehicle

ownershipResolution.retainedMinority: Original investors retained a collective minority interest; their complete identities and individual percentages are not publicly disclosed.
ownershipResolution.commitment: The sponsors announced aggregate commitments of up to US$500 million. The May 15, 2025 Form D reported US$435 million sold; do not describe the entire US$500 million as funded at announcement.
ownershipResolution.exitSearch: No Takanock sale, realization, sponsor exit, or pending company-level ownership transaction was identified through August 13, 2026. ArcLight's live investment page continues to list Digital Generation as Current. DigitalBridge's pending acquisition of ArcLight and SoftBank's pending acquisition of DigitalBridge are manager-level transactions and do not change Takanock's legal owner rows.

companyResolution.operatingProfile: Takanock develops power-enabled sites and permanent on-site generation for data centers, including late-stage deployments in Northern Virginia and Phoenix.
